title: Chapter 301: The Zerg Is Nominated As A Major Clan
content:
Chapter 301: The Zerg Is Nominated As A Major Clan

The alien race has drawn more troops from the 108th District of the Southern Theater Public Battlefield. More than 55 million Zerg troops, like an endless black tide, rushed to the main city of the alien race without any hindrance.

The Zerg army ignored the alien cities encountered on the army's route. As long as the alien army did not leave the city to block, the Zerg army would not take the initiative to attack.

The Zerg army set out at dawn and arrived at the main city protection area of the 108th District of the alien race at noon.

This is the result of accommodating the slowest Zerg ground forces. If the Zerg air force is at full speed, it will not take a long time to fly this distance.

The alien race has already obtained intelligence about the Zerg army's attack. No alien army can be seen outside the main city. All the troops have retreated to the main city, and the whole city has entered a state of preparation for war.

The Zerg army went straight ahead and rushed to the outside of the main city of the alien race.

Wu Qing saw the main city again. He looked through the high-altitude Zerg host. The Zerg army of more than 50 million, which seemed very huge and terrifying, seemed insignificant in front of the huge main city. These troops could not even surround the city.

GOOGLE search TWKAN

The main city of this public battlefield has a population of hundreds of millions and covers an extremely large area. It is the base camp of the two major camps and has extraordinary significance.

If the main city is breached, it is not a matter of losing troops, but a loss of the fortune of the camp, and the defeated race will be affected more.

The alien race was so strong that it could not capture the main city of the local camp. That was because when the main city was attacked, the major tribes of the local camp would personally take action.

It can be said that the major main cities in the public war zone are the foundation of the two camps, and other wins and losses are just minor details.

The Zerg army launched an active attack on the main city of the alien race. Those who followed and watched the battle were not only observers from various forces, but also many powerful people from various tribes.

In order to better detect the hidden strongmen of both sides, Wu Qing upgraded a batch of six-star Zerg hosts. With their existence, the actions of the strongmen of all parties could not escape the eyes of the Zerg.

…

The Zerg puppies and type three Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, which had the largest number of troops in the Zerg army, continued to disperse after the Zerg main battle force stopped advancing, scattered into the surrounding areas, drilled into the ground, and slowly disappeared.

Outside the huge main city of the alien race, there were less than five million Zerg main battle forces left, and they began to deploy troops.

Less than five million troops may not be able to fill a slightly larger barracks in the main city, but the rapid deployment of the Zerg army of less than five million has put the main city of the alien race on high alert.

The fully deployed Zerg main battle force, this time 500,000 Zerg destroyers were directly placed on the front line, and their range was just enough to reach the wall of the main city of the alien race.

The Zerg Destroyers are far apart, and the Zerg Hydralisks and Type II Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions are in between to provide air defense protection.

Zerg Stealth Spiders have all gone underground to prevent the ground attack of the alien army.

Zerg Cockroaches cannot defend against air attacks due to range issues, so they can only serve as the last line of defense for close combat. It is difficult for the current enemies to rush into this area, and they seem a bit marginalized.

Zerg air forces, as auxiliary fire output Zerg Explosive Swarms, are quite numerous this time.

Twenty thousand five-star Zerg Air Guards have been lined up and are ready to launch an attack.

With the Zerg main combat force placed in this position, only the Zerg Air Guards can launch an attack calmly.

Wu Qing saw through the Zerg host that a large number of ultra-long-range siege equipment were deployed in the main city of the aliens. If the Zerg army wants to launch a full-scale attack, it must first destroy these weapons that pose the greatest threat.

The battle of the Zerg army attacking the main city of the aliens will be more complicated. Once it starts, it will not end in a short time.

The Zerg have to face not only the alien race, but also the entire evil god camp and the local camp, and various factors are complicated.

From the sky, the scale of the Zerg main battle force outside the alien race’s main city is a bit like an ant shaking a tree compared to the population size in the city.

The reason why Wu Qing dared to do this is because the population in the main city is mostly ordinary people, and a Zerg puppy can slaughter a group.

The Zerg’s first sub-base, which has further expanded its scale, can deliver a large number of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions to the battlefield at all times.

Because of the distance and the strange influence of the night, the delivery of Zerg troops will encounter some problems, but it will not affect the final result.

The Zerg reinforcements, which are counted in hundreds of millions, will eventually be put into this war.

Before the Zerg army goes to war, the Zerg host and Zerg puppy go first.

The Zerg host flies stealthily in the sky, and the Zerg puppies are scattered on the ground. The two work together to provide the Zerg army with the most accurate real-time intelligence.

The Zerg army must win every battle, and they play an extremely important role.

Everything was ready, and Wu Qing finally gave the order to attack.

Twenty thousand five-star Zerg air guards opened fire. Their first target was not the ultra-long-range siege equipment of the aliens that had been discovered by the Zerg host, but the solid wall in front of the Zerg main battle force.

The single-point attack mode of the five-star Zerg air guards was very powerful, and the tall, solid, and heavy main city walls could not withstand such a strong attack.

In the game setting, the Zerg Sky Guards have a powerful ability to destroy buildings, and this ability has also been brought to reality.

20,000 assault bombs hit a section of the main city wall, and the foundation of the entire section of the wall was destroyed. The alien army stationed on the wall suffered collateral damage and suffered heavy casualties.

Some five-star Zerg Sky Guards switched to the coverage attack mode and attacked the main city wall whose foundation was destroyed.

"Boom...!" With a loud bang, the entire section of the city wall that was attacked became a pile of ruins.

"It seems that the city wall collapsed!"

"Was the city wall breached so quickly?"

"..."

The soldiers and civilians who defended the city were most afraid of the city wall being breached. Even if all the soldiers and civilians in the alien city had firm beliefs, the breach of the city wall would still have a certain impact on them.

The five-star Zerg Sky Guards continued to attack. According to the attack method just now, they soon opened a huge gap in the city wall of the alien city near the main Zerg combat force.

The collapsed city wall has little practical effect on the Zerg army, but it is of great significance.

After the 20,000 five-star Zerg air guards broke down the city wall, they began to formally attack the ultra-long-range siege equipment deployed in the main city of the alien race.

Even if those precious ultra-long-range siege equipment are protected by powerful energy defense shields, they cannot stop the single-point attack mode of the five-star Zerg air guards.

The ultra-long-range siege equipment deployed in the main city of the alien race was constantly destroyed, and the alien army had no way to deal with it.

Everyone finally saw the beyond-visual-range range of the five-star Zerg air guards. As the Zerg air guards continued to rise in height, the ultra-long-range siege equipment in the far distance of the alien main city could not escape the attack.

With the Zerg air guards, a soldier with extremely long range and super strong attack power, many powerful soldiers of the alien race dare not show up easily.

After the previous war, the Zerg and the alien race are very familiar with each other.

There were powerful alien mages who wanted to use the mage building in the main city to try to launch battlefield magic, but they were immediately detected by the Zerg host, who commanded the five-star Zerg air guards to destroy the mage building.

Those alien mages did not escape the powerful attack of the Zerg air guards.

The aliens tried to fight back, but after finding that the effect was not good, they let the Zerg air guards attack.

The alien city can easily withstand the attack of 20,000 five-star Zerg air guards. The Zerg cannot capture a city of this level with just this one unit, and other units will eventually be needed to join the battle.

After destroying all the valuable targets within the effective range of the alien city, the 20,000 five-star Zerg air guards stopped attacking.

After destroying all the ultra-long-range siege equipment of the aliens, the Zerg main battle force began to advance, using the ultra-long-range firepower of 500,000 Zerg destroyers to cover the defenders in the alien city.

The Zerg army and the alien human army started another war of attrition without much novelty.

…

In an unknown place in this world, the full-power representatives of various super tribes and tribes in the local camp were continuously transmitted through the space transmission channel.

The representatives of the super tribe Goblin tribe and the tribe Naga tribe came early.

At the appointed time, hundreds of representatives of various tribes had arrived.

The representatives of various tribes took their seats in turn.

If Wu Qing came here, in addition to the Goblin tribe, Naga tribe and Tengu tribe, he could also recognize limited tribes such as the Human tribe, the Lion tribe, the Giant tribe, and many more tribes that he had never seen before.

"A new batch of great tribes is about to be born. There are only five places for this batch of great tribes, which is far from enough to make up for the vacancies left by our brother races who have lost their great tribe status!"

"Our situation is not good on both battlefields. I hope that everyone can select five truly powerful great tribes this time to share the pressure with us!"

"There are already hundreds of recommended races in the previous batch. Do you have any temporary recommended races?"

The giant who was over ten meters tall, without any courtesy or foreshadowing, went straight to the theme of this conference.

The great tribes of the local camp present have basically coordinated their interests in private. This time, the five great tribes that are about to be born will be selected from the races that everyone has recommended long ago.

Among the candidate races, there are the bear tribe, the wolf tribe and the eagle tribe.

Generally, this temporary recommendation of races is just a formality. Few great tribes will suddenly come up with a race at this time.

However, today is a little different.

The representatives of the goblin tribe and the Naga tribe looked at each other, and the small goblin representative said loudly: "The goblin tribe and the Naga tribe jointly recommend the Zerg!"
